newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Excel Economico to open investment bank.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Excel Economico to open investment bank.

text.p: Brazilian private retail bank Excel Economico said it is hiring a team of executives to set up its investment bank, which it expects will be open for business late March.
Excel Economico has already hired former Industry and Commerce Minister Dorothea Werneck to be one of its top executives, said a bank spokesman.
The investment bank will be born with an initial capital of 20 million reais and will focus on asset management, privatizations and mergers and acquisitions.
Switzerland's Union Bancaire Privee (UBP), which already owns 44 percent of Excel Economico's capital, is likely to have up to 49 percent of the investment bank's capital, the spokesman added.
Excel Economico opened for business in May 1996 after Excel Banco took over selected assets and liabilities of failed bank Banco Economico, which collapsed due to a huge liquidity shortfall.
